column1: # en -> uk bridging for `vault find`. Agents query in English against a 100%
# Ukrainian corpus; without this, find returns nothing and the agent falls back
# to full-file Reads, which defeats the whole retrieval layer.
# Matching is prefix-based (>=3 chars), so stems are enough — do not list
# inflected forms. Bidirectional: any token on a line expands to all others.
